reason: Ninjutsu Kaito gets 3 extra damage in and a planeswalker onto the board, and Kaito's -2 stuns the equipped 4/3 Miner for two turns; A only adds a 2/1 and keeps Kaito in hand.
Both wipe the Hellkite and keep indestructible Marvel; the extra land and Three Steps Ahead's draw against an opponent with no cards in hand barely change anything.
Bouncing a Hellkite that gets recast next turn is weak tempo; A keeps UU up to flash in Eddymurk Crab (cheap after the Sleights) or Burst Lightning on the opponent's turn.
Without a block Kaito takes 4 and dies; chumping Prowler with the 1/1 Yuriko keeps Kaito alive at 2 loyalty.
A second Starcage would exile only a Pest token; holding up the Three Steps Ahead counter, then Consult the Star Charts at end step, uses the mana far better.
With both attacking, 9 damage is lethal against 7 life, so Hellkite must block and either dies or lets 5 through; keeping Hearth Elemental home does nothing against flyers.
A 1/1 Illusion token trades with Starscape Cleric, the opponent's drain engine, and their deck has no combat tricks.
Two Torches now exile both Forsaken Miners (so they cannot come back) against an empty hand, and the tapped Crypt costs no life at 9; A risks holding removal and paying 2 life.

Sacrificing a Treasure to Bargain leaves Misty Mountains Cold one short of four Treasures at chapter IV, so no 6/6 Dragon, and the second Conqueror keeps the Treasures locked anyway; holding Torch keeps the Dragon on schedule.
At 56 life, holding the Illusions back as blockers is pointless; attacking with everything adds damage and pressure against tiny blockers.
